paragraphs: This Termux bash setup shell script will attempt to set Arch Linux up in your Termux environment. Use bash setupTermuxArch.bash to install Arch Linux in a Termux PRoot container on your Android smartphone and tablet, and Chromebook too. When successfully completed, you will be experiencing the pleasure of the Linux command prompt in Arch Linux in Termux on your device. See for options how to run setupTermuxArch.bash on device. This repository uses submodules. Please run pullTermuxArchSubmodules.bash in the [TermuxArch]( repository root directory after cloning to get all the pieces of this…

Thank you for making this project work better and please contribute 🔆 See for more information. Please visit the Termux wiki website at for more information about playing and/or working with Linux on device in Termux.
